{"subject":"Onboarding new AEs at vCluster","body":"Hi Laurie,

I saw vCluster has 7 open sales roles, the newest posted 4 days ago, including Federal Account Executive and Enterprise Account Executive, plus SDR roles in NYC and the SF Bay Area.

When new reps start, a pipeline process helps them get going. Quillpath reads your CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce) every night, flags stalled deals each morning, and gives each rep a short list of next actions per deal. Setup takes about 15 minutes, and nothing needs to be migrated.

Would you want to run the free 14-day pilot on your real pipeline before the new reps start?","missing":["Which CRM vCluster uses (HubSpot or Salesforce)","Whether vCluster already has a pipeline review process or RevOps owner","Laurie's specific responsibilities for international sales hiring"]}
